title: Chatot Perap AR 081/071 sv5K Wild Force Japanese Pokemon Card Art Rare
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Pokemon Japanese - Chatot (Perap) Art Rare 081/071 - sv5K Wild Force

Japanese-language Art Rare (AR) from Scarlet & Violet series set sv5K
"Wild Force". Card number 081/071, illustrated by Scov, (c) 2024 Pokemon.

- Pokemon: Chatot / Perap (Colorless, 70 HP, Basic)
- Rarity: Art Rare (AR) - full-art alternate illustration
- Card number: 081/071
- Set: sv5K Wild Force (Japanese)
- Illustrator: Scov
- Ungraded, raw single

Condition: Pulled and sleeved straight away, handled by the edges. Front and
back are both photographed - please judge corners, edges, surface and
centering for yourself from the images, as they are of the actual card you
will receive. Shown in a semi-rigid holder in the photos.
